The answer type is a count (cardinality: single number).  
The key phrase is "already appeared in" – meaning films where she has actually performed, not just announced or filming.  

Looking at the table, the "Notes" column contains statuses like "Filming", "Announced", and also award info.  
Rows where she has appeared should have a role listed and likely no "Filming" or "Announced" status in Notes.

All others have a role filled and no "Filming"/"Announced" in Notes (except Bahaddoor which has "Filming" but also a role – but "Filming" means not yet released, so not already appeared).
